content.comment_body: Good evening! Could you please share a link to download the [product_name] Access Tool software? I'm unable to download it from the official website.

Hello [user_name], welcome to the forum. This is an English-speaking community, so please write your future posts in English. The official [company_name] website was recently updated, which is why the previous download link no longer works. The [product_name] Access Tool can now be downloaded from the new page, but the process is export restricted. You need to register and log in to download export-restricted software. What information is required for this registration?

Hello! I needed to export data from [product_name] to Microsoft Excel for processing. The [product_name] Access Tool isn’t available for direct download on the official site. I registered on the site and would appreciate any assistance.
If you completed the additional registration and received the email from [company_name] confirming your release for the download, you should be able to access it on the official website.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are experiencing difficulties obtaining the [product_name] Access Tool due to confusing navigation changes on the [company_name] site and strict export restriction registration requirements. The download process is unclear, and important instructions are not well communicated, hindering users from acquiring essential software for exporting data.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect a simple and accessible process to download the [product_name] Access Tool, along with clear guidance for exporting data from [product_name] to Microsoft Excel.
